newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil, Texaco swap UK oil asset.
newsitem.headline: Statoil, Texaco swap UK oil asset.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had acquired an eight percent stake in North Sea block 3/28a under a swap deal with Texaco of assets on the British continental shelf.
In exchange, the U.S. oil major will receive 10 percent of block 30/2c and 0.375 percent in 21/14a.
Norway's state-owned oil company announced a week ago a major round of asset swaps, acquisitions and sales on both the British and Norwegian continental shelves.
Statoil said the exchange of interests with Texaco strengthened the overall portfolio of both companies and their positions in areas of existing involvement.
"Acquiring a stake in 3/28a gives Statoil additional access to Bressay, a big heavy oil discovery which has aroused great expectations," the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Statoil already holds 20 percent of block 3/27.
It said it was interested in contributing technical experience and expertise to identifying alternative solutions, which could make development of Bressay profitable for all licensees.
Under the deal Texaco reinforces its position in developing the Jade area in block 30/2c.
